records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Freight revenue increased 29% during the second quarter of 2021 compared to 2020, resulting from a 22% volume increase, higher fuel surcharge revenue, and core pricing gains.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: After freight revenues declined 24% year-over-year in the second quarter of 2020 driven by the economic impact of COVID-19 and the economic shutdown that reduced volumes by 20%, our second quarter of 2021 freight revenues increased 29% compared to the same period in 2020 driven by a 6% higher average revenue per car (ARC) and a 22% volume increase.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company reported earnings of $2.72 per diluted share on net income of $1.8 billion and an operating ratio of 55.1% in the second quarter of 2021 compared to earnings of $1.67 per diluted share on net income of $1.1 billion and an operating ratio of 61.0% for the second quarter of 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The ARC increase was due to higher fuel surcharge revenue and core pricing gains.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: After operating income decreased 27% year-over-year in the second quarter of 2020, our second quarter of 2021 operating income increased 50% compared to the same period in 2020.
